name: Infinite Life
source:
"Infinite Life" is a hit new VR sim that's causing a lot of buzz! For Lyra and Klara though, it's causing them confusion! The real world may be a dull, lifeless, sad drone of mundane experiences and false existences, IL is a world popping with color and life! INFINITE life, you could say! 

Join them on this journey of self-exploration, though be warned... what they find may not be what you like. Or expect!

[From [url=https://mezzynine.itch.io/infinite-life]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“无限生命”是一款热门的新VR模拟游戏，引起了广泛关注！但对于莱拉和克拉拉来说，这让他们感到困惑！现实世界可能是平淡、无生气、悲伤的平凡经历和虚假存在的嗡嗡声，而IL是一个充满色彩和生命的世界！你可以说，生命无限！

加入他们的自我探索之旅，但要注意……他们发现的可能不是你喜欢的。或者期待！

[来自[url=https://mezzynine.itch.io/infinite-life]itch.io[/url]]
